# hairstyle.company

> A curated edit of human hair wigs and hair care from UNice, Zlike, Allove Hair and Jumy Bee. Glueless, HD lace and every texture, explained simply.

Independent affiliate edit; products are sold by the official brand stores.

## Guides
- [HD Lace vs Transparent Lace (and 4x4 vs 7x5 vs 13x4 vs 13x6)](https://hairstyle.company/guides/hd-lace-vs-transparent-lace.html): HD lace is the thinnest, most invisible lace and melts into most skin tones. Transparent lace is slightly thicker and more durable. For size, 7x5 glueless is the easiest for beginners, while 13x4 and 13x6 frontals give ear-to-ear hairlines and the most parting freedom.
- [Glueless Wigs for Beginners: How to Choose and Wear One](https://hairstyle.company/guides/glueless-wigs-for-beginners.html): A glueless wig stays on with an adjustable elastic band, drawstring and combs instead of adhesive. Look for pre-cut lace, pre-plucked hairline and bleached knots, then fit the cap, secure the band and set the hairline. It takes about 5 minutes with no glue.
- [Wig Density & Length Guide: 150% vs 180% vs 250%](https://hairstyle.company/guides/wig-density-and-length-guide.html): 150% looks natural and light, 180% is the popular full everyday look, and 250-300% is extra glam volume. Length is measured with the hair stretched straight, so curly and wavy wigs look several inches shorter than the stated length.
- [How to Care for a Human Hair Wig (So It Lasts)](https://hairstyle.company/guides/human-hair-wig-care.html): Wash every 7-10 wears with sulfate-free shampoo, condition from mid-lengths to ends, detangle gently from the ends up, air-dry on a stand, use heat protectant before styling and store the wig on a stand or in a silk bag. With good care, human hair wigs can last a year or more.
- [How to Choose the Best Wig for Your Face Shape](https://hairstyle.company/guides/best-wig-for-your-face-shape.html): Round faces suit long layers and side parts; square faces soften with waves and curls; heart shapes suit chin-length bobs and volume at the jaw; oval faces can wear almost anything; long faces suit shoulder-length cuts, curtain bangs and width at the sides.

## Collections
- [Glueless Wigs](https://hairstyle.company/collections/glueless-wigs.html): Wear-and-go wigs that stay put with elastic bands, drawstrings and combs, so no glue or tape is needed. Ideal for beginners and quick changes.
- [HD Lace Wigs](https://hairstyle.company/collections/hd-lace-wigs.html): Ultra-thin HD lace that melts into most skin tones for an undetectable hairline, even up close.
- [Lace Front & Lace Wigs](https://hairstyle.company/collections/lace-wigs.html): Every lace style in one place: 4x4 and 5x5 closures, 7x5 glueless, 13x4 and 13x6 frontals, 360 and full lace.
- [Body Wave Wigs](https://hairstyle.company/collections/body-wave.html): Soft, S-shaped waves with natural volume. Body wave is one of the easiest textures to maintain day to day.
- [Curly Wigs](https://hairstyle.company/collections/curly-hair.html): Kinky curly, Burmese curls, afro coils and bouncy ringlets, with defined texture and lived-in softness.
- [Straight Wigs](https://hairstyle.company/collections/straight-hair.html): Silky, bone and yaki straight styles, sleek and polished for every day.
- [Deep & Water Wave Wigs](https://hairstyle.company/collections/deep-wave.html): Romantic deep waves and water waves that hold their shape and look full from root to tip.
- [Bob & Short Wigs](https://hairstyle.company/collections/bob-short-wigs.html): Pre-styled bobs, pixies and shoulder-length cuts. Lightweight, lower-maintenance and quick to wear.
- [Blonde Wigs](https://hairstyle.company/collections/blonde-hair.html): 613 platinum, honey blonde and butterscotch tones, from bold statement blonde to soft, sun-kissed shades.
- [Colored & Highlight Wigs](https://hairstyle.company/collections/colored-hair.html): Balayage, ombre, ginger, reddish brown and money-piece highlights. Color without the salon chair.
- [Hair Care & Keratin Treatments](https://hairstyle.company/collections/hair-care.html): Formaldehyde-free keratin smoothing, Japanese botox-style hair masks, after-care and styling tools.
